task.title: Release: owner-side, non-destructive electron-builder tool-cache provisioning script
task.objective: Owner prompt 2026-11-08 'Secure electron-builder Cache Provisioning and N7 Packaging Recovery': replace the earlier inline owner snippet (which accepted 7za exit 2, trusted existing cache folders, extracted straight into the cache and removed a staged archive) with scripts/release-provision-electron-builder-tools.ps1. For winCodeSign 2.6.0, nsis 3.0.4.1 and nsis-resources 3.4.1 it verifies the source archive and a staged copy against the SHA-512 pins in scripts/verify-packaging-host.mjs, inspects the archive inventory (path safety; only the pinned macOS-only symbolic links may be excluded), extracts with the bundled 7za into a unique work folder outside the cache requiring exit 0, validates the work folder with the H3c comparison, promotes by a same-volume no-overwrite rename, re-verifies in place, and preserves every existing or unverified folder. The owner runs it manually; agents never run it. It changes nothing in the repository and needs no administrator rights.

acceptance.description: The script fails closed on missing or mismatched inputs, accepts only 7za exit 0, never overwrites, deletes or reuses an unverified folder, promotes only H3c-verified content, prints per-tool evidence and a final PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED; an independent read-only review finds no blocking defect.

evidence.observed: 2026-11-08 verdict APPROVE WITH CHANGES; no path found by which the script's own extract-and-promote flow could promote an incomplete or tampered folder; ASCII-only, return values clean, native stderr captured, pin regex and -slt parsing agree with the verifier, File.Move/Directory.Move refuse to overwrite, only 7za exit 0 accepted. Applied: (1) rollback failure now prints UNVERIFIED FOLDER LEFT IN CACHE; (2) every H3c call passes --builder-cache explicitly, the PASS line must name the exact folder, a relative ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE is BLOCKED; (3) verifier counts links/junctions as extra and inspects with lstat; (4) failed checks print the verifier's tool lines or its last lines, and H2 requires zlib.crc32; nits: pinned link paths must be absent, 7za chosen by node's process.arch in both, rerun falls back to a verified staged archive, staging/work may not overlap the cache, empty-folder removal checks emptiness first. PowerShell parse check BLOCKED for the reviewer by the command guard; the script has not been executed (owner-side by design).

history.released_reason: owner provisioning script written and corrected after independent review findings 1-4 and nits 6-9
commit gate BLOCKED for the agent: staged set mixes the release-owned script with docs and contracts, owner commits from the terminal
